title: scPASU: A computational protocol for quantifying polyadenylation site usage from scRNA-seq data
author: Krylova, Alexandra
materials: Submit Snakemake command to run module 1:
Submit Snakemake command to run module 2:
Submit Snakemake command to run module 3:
Submit Snakemake command to run module 4:
Submit Snakemake command to run module 5:

steps.title: Prepare data and filter reads
steps.instruction: Run the first Snakemake pipeline (module 1) to build a GTF reference database, remove PCR duplicates and ambiguous reads, filter genomic‑A‑primed reads, subset BAMs for selected cell types, and merge BAMs before and after filtering; optional QC generates BigWig tracks. Use the appropriate Snakemake command (see note on version 8.01).

substeps.instruction: Create reference database from the GTF file with polyAfilter (rule create_gtf_db) → writes gtfb.db to folder 1b.
Remove PCR duplicates (rule preprocess_bam_dedup) → writes to folder 1a1.
Remove ambiguously mapped reads (rule preprocess_bam_cleanup) → writes to folder 1a2.
Filter genomic‑A‑primed reads (rules genomicA_filtering_create_trans_file, genomicA_filtering_first_round, genomicA_filtering_second_round) → writes to folder 1b.
Subset processed BAMs by user‑provided cell‑barcode list (rule subset_bams) → writes to folder 1c.
Merge subsetted BAMs before genomic‑A filtering (rule merge_bam_before_filt) → writes to folder 1d.
Merge subsetted BAMs after genomic‑A filtering (rule merge_bam_after_filt) → writes to folder 1d.
Optional QC: generate BigWig files before filtering (rule bw_track_before_filt) and after filtering (rule bw_track_after_filt) for UCSC browser viewing.

steps.title: Call and refine poly(A) sites
steps.instruction: Run the second Snakemake pipeline (module 2) to call candidate poly(A) site peaks from the processed reads, incorporate poly(A) junction evidence, split overlapping signals, and produce branch‑specific peak reference files.

substeps.instruction: Cluster reads with MACS2 (rule all_filtered_reads_peak_call_summits) → outputs to folder 2a.
Identify poly(A) junction reads with samToPolyA (rule all_filtered_reads_sam_to_polyA) → outputs to folder 2b (after_genomicAfiltering).
Detect poly(A) junction reads (rule polyAreads_sam_to_polyA) → writes to folder 2b (before_genomicAfiltering).
Subset BAM by junction‑read names (rule polyAreads_filterbam_byreadnames) → writes to folder 2b (before_genomicAfiltering).
Cluster junction reads (rule polyAreads_peak_call_summits) → writes to folder 2a (polyA_reads).
Compute coverage for all filtered reads (rule bam_coverage_all_filtered_reads) and for polyA reads (rule bam_coverage_polyA_reads) → writes to folder 2c1.
Split multimodal signals where gaps exist (rules split_peak_ref_all_filtered_reads, split_peak_ref_polyA_reads) → writes to folder 2c2.
Generate branch‑specific peak reference files retaining only junction‑read‑supported peaks (rules peak_ref_all_filtered_reads, peak_ref_polyA_reads) → writes to folder 2d.

steps.title: Assign peaks to transcriptional units
steps.instruction: Run the third Snakemake pipeline (module 3) to build a transcriptional‑unit (TU) reference, assign candidate peaks to TUs (including a 5 kb 3′ extension), apply length and usage filters (≥ 1,000 bp region, ≥ 10 % per‑gene usage), optionally filter by poly(A) signal, merge the two processing branches, classify peaks by genomic context, and flag fragmented peaks; optional QC creates tracks and statistics.

substeps.instruction: Build TU reference from alignment GTF, extending each TU 5 kb downstream (rule create_turef) → outputs to folder 3a.
Assign peaks overlapping a single TU or its 3′ flank for all‑filtered reads and polyA reads (rules assign_tu_all_filtered_reads, assign_tu_polyA_reads) → writes to folder 3a.

Filter peaks by processing‑region length (default 1,000 bp) and minimum per‑gene usage (default 10 %) (rules update_peak_ref_all_filtered_reads, update_peak_ref_polyA_reads); optionally retain peaks with poly(A) signal (PAS_filtering = true) or proximity to annotated transcript ends → writes to folders 3b1, 3b3, 3b4 (and optionally 3b2).
Merge filtered peaks from both branches into a final peak reference (rule merge_two_prongs) → writes to folder 3c.
Classify peaks by genomic context in priority order: 3′ UTR, TSS‑proximal, Exonic, Intronic, Flank (rule peak_classification) → writes to folder 3d.
Identify fragmented peaks likely caused by spliced alignments (rule identify_fragmented_peaks).
Optional QC: generate BigWig tracks (rule make_filtered_tracks), plot nucleotide frequency (rule plot_nuc_freq), and compute peak‑filtering statistics (rule pa_ref_stats).

steps.title: Generate peak‑by‑cell count matrices
steps.instruction: Run the fourth Snakemake pipeline (module 4) to convert the finalized peak reference into a Cell Ranger‑compatible reference, transform filtered BAMs to FASTQ, and use Cell Ranger to produce per‑sample peak‑by‑cell count matrices; optionally also generate a standard gene‑by‑cell matrix.

substeps.instruction: Build Cell Ranger‑compatible reference from Module 3 peak reference (rule cellranger_make_scPASU_ref).
Convert filtered BAM files (folder 1c) to FASTQ (rule bam_to_fastq) → writes to folder 4a.
Run Cell Ranger count with the FASTQs and peak reference to create peak‑by‑cell matrices (rule cellranger_peakcount) → writes to folder 4b.
Optional: generate gene‑by‑cell count matrices for downstream differential expression (rule cellranger_genecount).

steps.title: Optional downstream analysis scripts
steps.instruction: Run the fifth Snakemake pipeline (module 5) to merge per‑sample count matrices, perform APA significance testing and pseudo‑bulk DEG testing, and create UCSC‑compatible visualization tracks; all steps are optional.

substeps.instruction: Merge per‑sample peak count matrices and optionally edit cell barcodes to match a user‑provided Seurat object (rule merge_per_sample_peakcounts) → writes to folder 5a.
Merge per‑sample gene count matrices (rule merge_per_sample_genecounts) → writes to folder 5a.
Perform APA significance testing between two user‑defined cell groups (rule APA_testing) → writes to folder 5b.
Conduct pseudo‑bulk differential gene expression testing (rule DEG_testing) → writes to folder 5b.
Convert APA bedGraph files to fractional‑usage tracks for UCSC Genome Browser (rule make_fractional_tracks).
Generate a reference bigBed file annotating peaks for UCSC visualization (rule make_track_annotations).
